evidence.claim: Three transactions of ~$100 each occurred within 70 minutes on card C04570-K1, indicating card testing.
Flagged transaction used a new device profile shared by 5 cards across 5 distinct customers, suggesting a fraud ring.
Card C04570-K1 shares 21 device profiles with 10+ connected cards including C11923-K2, confirming coordinated activity.
Transaction emails are anonymous.com and region is 204.0, departing from historical baseline of real email domains and regions 299.0/315.0.
Similar closed cases CC-3878, CC-4654, CC-3954 with identical pattern and ~$300 exposure were all confirmed fraud.
New-device CNP is a stronger signal than plain CNP but not standalone proof; must be weighed with history per policy.

sar.narrative: Card C04570-K1 was used in a rapid card-testing burst of 3 transactions (~$100 each) within 70 minutes from a new device. This device profile is shared with 4 other customer cards (C05876-K2, C09933-K2, C07987-K2, C02354-K2), indicating a coordinated fraud ring. Emails used were anonymous.com, deviating from the cardholder's historical baseline. Three similar prior cases resulted in confirmed fraud. Total exposure $300.14.
